description: The Geothermal Energy Impact Estimator calculates life-cycle environmental impacts, including carbon emissions, for existing or proposed geothermal plants. The Science for Clean Energy project publishes the application as C# source, with an archived .NET 6 release on Zenodo. The source repository assigns the MIT licence, allowing free reuse. Users provide plant-specific parameters, so geographic coverage and the assessment period depend on the case being modelled. The accompanying publication describes examples in Iceland and the United Kingdom, and a separate repository deposit provides their spreadsheet inputs and outputs. Results have limitations determined by life-cycle boundaries and the chosen plant assumptions; they are not a universal emission factor for geothermal generation. The software can compare infrastructure design or investment scenarios. No directly related catalogue record was found, and execution was not tested.
